title: Common identifiers
description: Shared identifier grammars, referenced as urn:alixai:schema:common:ids:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: An opaque, host-chosen identifier (deployment, application, tenant, workspace, principal, session, role, capability, entity, trace). 1 to 128 characters, no whitespace, no control characters and no '*': wildcards do not exist. Mirrors pkg/contracts scopeValueState.
identifier.$comment: The pattern excludes exactly what Go's unicode.IsSpace and unicode.IsControl reject, written as literal characters so it behaves the same in RE2 and ECMA-262 engines: U+0000-U+0020, U+007F-U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, plus '*'. pkg/contracts TestIdentifierGrammarMatchesSchema checks every BMP code point against scopeValueState.

capabilityId.title: Capability ID
capabilityId.description: The stable ID of an application capability. Exact match only; there are no capability wildcards.

traceId.title: Trace ID
traceId.description: Opaque model/provider trace identifier used to correlate a structured object with the inference call that produced it.

fieldName.title: Field name
fieldName.description: The name of a typed capability field: lower snake_case, at most 64 characters.

typedId.title: Typed core-minted ID
typedId.description: An ID minted by the AlixAI core: a short lowercase type prefix, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case), for example ses_01J0000000000000000000000A.
